meta.source: ESPN scoreboard APIs (DraftKings totals + juice) + BartTorvik T-Rank adjusted efficiency/tempo (NCAAB) + TeamRankings points-per-play / opponent points-per-play / plays-per-game (NCAAF), read 2026-11-08 ~08:15 AM ET
meta.method: NCAAB (Frank reel DfP12JtAPdv): team score = own possessions/game x (own offensive efficiency + opponent defensive efficiency) / 2, both teams summed. Inputs: BartTorvik AdjOE/AdjDE (per 100 poss) and AdjT — closest public equivalents to Frank's per-possession efficiency + possessions inputs (adaptation labeled on the board). NCAAF (Frank reel DexGq9mAXd2): team score = own plays/game x (own points per play + opponent points allowed per play) / 2, both teams summed. Inputs: TeamRankings points per play / opponent points per play / plays per game. Flag OVER at projected >= book + gap, UNDER at projected <= book - gap; gap = 5.0 NCAAB / 3.0 NCAAF (CHET'S DISPLAY CHOICE, NOT Frank's claim — the reels state no threshold and no win-rate claim). Separate from the Football Totals signal board.
